note: PM run. Checked 75 people and filed 14 bullets across 7 people, each verified on its source page by the parent and read back in the Sheet exactly once. Fresh sweep: none found — every in-window directory item was already filed (Evans and Goettl's Nov 14 Brown goals, Tebo's Nov 13 goal, Spademan's Yale goal, Levendusky's Bill Farrell seeding), and Adria Tebo's Nov 14 line was two blocked shots, a minor stat that was not filed; all three fresh slots were left empty rather than stretched. Strongest find: Sunday Wright Smith's New York Midwives leadership bio carried five new facts — she serves as Secretary of New York Midwives, her Potsdam birth center recently became accredited, she has attended over 650 births in her current practice, she has taught for the Clarkson PA program and Stony Brook's midwifery program, and she was inducted as a Fellow of the American Academy of Nurse Midwives in May 2023; her blank companies field was filled with Clarkson University. Also filed: three Philip Lloyd Paige listings (781 Bagdad Rd in Potsdam, 333 Lakeshore Dr and 2309 County Route 35 in Norwood, all with NOCO Homestead LLC); Nevaeh Phillips's Texas UIL 6A Division II state championship with Katy High School (May 30, 2026; Katy ISD's report plus a photo caption naming her in the state semifinal); Colleen Cheney's Spring 2024 President's List semester (section-checked on the SUNY Canton page); Sam Mace's shared 2020 SUNY Potsdam team MVP honors from the compounding lane; two Nancy Hull Crane performances (2011 and 2013); and Haddon Brown's North Country birth and move to Wisconsin at age 8. Not filed: Alana Hoover's winter modified volleyball appointment was already on her record word for word in the live Sheet, so the batch claim was discarded; Paige's 245 Lakeshore Dr listing was held because his record already carries a 247 Lakeshore Dr listing and the two may be the same property. Two open items for JD, both left untouched: the compounding lane could not tie Sam Mace's on-file St. Lawrence University budget and planning bullets to her Potsdam lacrosse record (the SLU Finance page names a Samantha Mace in that role; the bullets came from JD's own Nov 9 filing of a one-anchor listing); and Cecilie Smith's building question is still open — the March 19, 2026 Massena minutes confirm the addendum items 36-48 were approved, but the addendum listing itself is still not public, and the district's fall 2025 directory (Nightengale Elementary) and March 2026 resignation listing (junior high) still point to different buildings. 5 candidates added to Research Command.
